title: 늦은 이유, 못 가는 이유 말하기: -거든요
objective: By the end, you can add -거든요 to verbs and adjectives in the present and past, and to nouns in the present. You can also use it after your main point to give a reason the listener doesn't know yet.
summary: This worksheet shows how to give a reason in everyday conversation with the sentence ending -거든요.

task.title: Give reasons with -거든요
task.line: Read each short dialogue and complete or fix B's answer using the right form of -거든요.

forms.when: Present. Add it to any stem, with or without a final consonant (가거든요, 먹거든요, 바쁘거든요).
forms.means: '(It's) because ~, you see.' Use it to give a reason the listener doesn't know yet.
forms.example: A: 이 카페에 자주 오네요. B: 네, 여기 커피가 정말 맛있거든요.
forms.exampleMeaning: A: You come to this café a lot. B: Yes, the coffee here is really good, you see.

forms.when: Past. Use it when the reason happened before now (갔거든요, 먹었거든요, 했거든요).
forms.example: A: 왜 이렇게 피곤해 보여요? B: 어제 밤늦게까지 일했거든요.
forms.exampleMeaning: A: Why do you look so tired? B: I worked until late last night, that's why.

forms.when: The noun ends in a consonant (학생이거든요, 날이거든요).
forms.example: A: 내일 회사에 안 가요? B: 네, 내일은 쉬는 날이거든요.
forms.exampleMeaning: A: Aren't you going to work tomorrow? B: No, tomorrow is a day off, you see.

forms.when: The noun ends in a vowel. In speech, people usually drop 이 here (친구거든요).
forms.example: A: 그 사람을 잘 알아요? B: 네, 대학교 친구거든요.
forms.exampleMeaning: A: Do you know that person well? B: Yes, we're friends from university, you see.

watchOut: 학생거든요 (X) → 학생이거든요 (O): If a noun ends in a consonant, you need 이.
지금 바쁘거든요 전화 못 받아요. (X) → 지금 전화 못 받아요. 바쁘거든요. (O): -거든요 ends the sentence. Say your main point first, then give the reason.
어제 잠을 못 자거든요. (X) → 어제 잠을 못 잤거든요. (O): If the reason happened in the past, use the past form.
exercises: Fill in the blank with 춥다 + -거든요 (present): A: 왜 창문을 닫아요? B: 좀 ____.
Write the noun + -(이)거든요 form: ① A: 왜 일찍 퇴근해요? B: 오늘이 아내 ____. (생일) ② A: 아버지가 약을 잘 아시네요. B: 네, 우리 아버지가 ____. (의사)
Fill in the blanks with the past form + -거든요: ① A: 목소리가 왜 그래요? B: 감기에 ____. (걸리다) ② A: 이 동네를 잘 아네요. B: 여기에서 3년 동안 ____. (살다)
Fix the word order and rewrite the sentence: 다리가 아프거든요 좀 앉을게요.
Answer in Korean with -거든요 (your reason: you have to work this Saturday): A: 이번 토요일에 같이 등산 갈래요? B: 미안해요. ____.
answers: ① 생일이거든요 ② 의사거든요 (의사이거든요 is also correct)
토요일에 일해야 하거든요 (일해야 되거든요 / 출근해야 하거든요)
